jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MBA, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:

- Derive strategic insights and drive business action via financial data and independent/external research

- Prepare and present materials to senior leadership

- Currently enrolled in an MBA program focused on finance, strategic management and/or technology

- Strategic and critical thinking mindset: able to think multiple steps ahead on the implications of financial decisions
